clips.title: The story
paras: Lord Arkkoroc is an ancient, towering sea giant who dwells within the ruined Temple of Arkkoran along the ragged coast of Azshara. Described by the demon hunter Loramus Thalipedes as a lesser deity, he holds sway over the surrounding waters and commands lesser sea giants who serve as his sons.

Reclining amidst the brine-crusted ruins of the Temple of Arkkoran, Lord Arkkoroc is far more than a typical sea giant. To hermits like Loramus Thalipedes, this colossal being is considered a lesser deity whose divine will shapes the surrounding waters. His sons patrol the crags and shallows around the sanctuary, enforcing his quiet dominion over Azshara's tempestuous shores.
